decision.rationale: per-video thresholds exceed the preregistered IQR/range stability limits. Preserve the banked swap and prioritize deterministic calibration plus recall expansion.

per_video_threshold_stability.definition: For videos with both labeled classes, choose the threshold maximizing conservative utility subject to labeled precision >=0.95 under the existing joint labeled/unlabeled cap.

stability_rule.justification: A reusable global operating point should keep the central half of video-specific thresholds within one 0.10 probability band and avoid more than 0.30 end-to-end drift.

precision_side_ceiling_addendum.curve_grid: exact if <= 257 unique positive scores, otherwise 257 positive-score quantiles
